job.name: Agentic Detection & Response Specialist
job.description:
• At Plain Security Studios, we’re transforming traditional SOC capabilities through automation, AI-assisted investigations, and agentic security workflows
  • As an Agentic Detection & Response Specialist, you’ll combine advanced threat investigations with security automation, detection engineering, and AI-driven response capabilities, helping build the next generation of security operations
  • Lead complex incident investigations and advanced security escalations
  • Analyze activity across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and SIEM platforms to determine scope, impact, and response actions
  • Design, build, and improve detection rules, correlation logic, and investigation queries
  • Develop security automations, integrations, and SOAR playbooks to streamline operational workflows
  • Collaborate with security architects and engineers to implement AI-assisted and agentic security capabilities
  • Identify opportunities to apply AI for investigation support, enrichment, evidence summarization, and response recommendations
  • Act as a technical reference for L1 and L2 analysts, improving escalations, procedures, and operational maturity
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on reducing alert fatigue, increasing detection quality, and improving response efficiency

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience: We offer competitive salaries that match both market trends and your unique experience and skills. We believe in rewarding the talent and dedication of our team.
  • Flexible 35-hour week: We promote a work-life balance with a flexible 35-hour work week, without any salary reduction. We prioritize your well-being and productivity.
  • 100% Remote work (optional): We provide the option for 100% remote work, allowing you to create a work environment that suits your personal needs and preferences.
  • Flexible remuneration (restaurant, transportation, and childcare): Our flexible remuneration package includes vouchers for restaurants, transportation, and childcare services
  • Free medical and dental insurance: We cover medical and dental insurance for you and your family, ensuring your health and well-being are always a priority, with no additional cost to you.
  • Training budget and free certifications: Invest in your growth with an individual training budget and access to free Microsoft certifications. We support your continuous learning and professional development.
  • English lessons: Enhance your language skills with weekly English lessons, designed to improve proficiency and confidence in a global work environment.
  • Day off for your birthday: Celebrate your birthday with a day off, on us! We believe in celebrating you and giving you the space to enjoy your special day.
  • Monthly bonus: Receive a monthly bonus to cover your electricity and internet expenses, ensuring you have everything you need for a comfortable and productive remote work setup.
  • Gym and sports discount: Stay active and healthy with discounts on gym memberships and sports activities. We encourage a healthy lifestyle for our team members.
  • Cutting-edge tech tools: Stay ahead of the curve with access to the latest technological tools. We ensure you have the best resources at your fingertips to drive innovation.
  • Annual team building events: Join us for Plain Camp, our annual team-building event designed to strengthen bonds and foster collaboration within our team in a fun and relaxed setting.
job.profile:
• Scripting and automation experience with Python, PowerShell, APIs, or SOAR technologies
  • Experience investigating threats across endpoint, identity, network, and cloud environments
  • Ability to own initiatives from idea to implementation and collaborate across technical teams
  • Experience with Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR, or equivalent security platforms
  • Interest in applying AI and Agentic Security concepts to real-world operations
  • Strong background in Incident Response, Threat Hunting, Detection Engineering, and Security Operations
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM and EDR/XDR technologies
  • Fluent Spanish and English
  • Strong query skills using KQL, SPL, or similar languages
  • 6+ years of experience in Security Operations (SOC) with solid experience managing L3 investigations or advanced escalations
  • Experience with AWS security services
  • Hands-on experience with Torq, Logic Apps, Azure Functions, or similar automation platforms
  • Security Copilot exposure
  • Experience in MDR/MSSP environments
  • Exposure to AI-assisted investigations, LLMs, agents, or orchestration frameworks
